source_tamil_lines: நாளும் உன கல்லறை மீதில் நாங்களும் கண்ணீர் சிந்தி
english_lines: You too, sacrificed to love, became a symbol of sacrifice;
You became a portrait in the hearts of the people!
So that whoever beholds you may understand
The courage of women, you became an image!
Having loved a wicked man, within married life
You saw unending sorrow and bore fruitless blame!
You killed your own lord and established justice!
A symbol of sacrifice that teaches the whole country a lesson,
Each day, upon your grave, we too shed tears,
There is no return we can offer except our love!
notes: `நாதன்` is rendered as `lord` in its husband/spouse sense without inserting a name not printed in the line.

translator_notes: The memorial/elegiac tone is preserved, including the movement from private love and sorrow to public justice and remembrance.
Item-level lyric authorship remains unresolved at this booklet-evidence tier; translation does not upgrade attribution.
